text:
Emma (Sales): quick sync request — ACME POC. Need to lock scope + success criteria today so SEs can start integration. Main asks: SDK auth, expected rate limits, streaming support, retry behavior, and pricing ballpark. Also security questionnaire outstanding.
Liam (SE): on it. can you share target use cases + sample prompts? helps size tokens and latency targets.
Emma (Sales): use case = in-app summarization + assisted search (embedding + rerank). sample prompts: "summarize last 3 messages" and multi-turn chat for followups. target = feature prototype in 2 weeks.
Noah (Solutions Engineer): suggested minimal eval set: 50 summarization prompts, 100 query -> embedding+rerank pairs. success criteria: quality (ROUGE/accuracy) + perf (p95 latency < 300ms for single-turn gen, embeddings <200ms).
Zoe (Product): add business metric: conversion lift on help widget >= 5% vs baseline.
Liam (SE): integration notes: recommend JS SDK for quick POC. auth = API key for hosted; for Dedicated/Private use mTLS or SSO + API tokens. SDK snippet: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'Summarize...' });
```
Also curl example auth header: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Liam (SE): streaming: supported via SSE/websocket on hosted. use `client.stream()` in SDK. fallback: non-streaming responses if client can't handle chunks.
Liam (SE): rate limits/quotas: default sandbox = 60 req/min, 10k tokens/min. For POC we can request a temporary bump — include expected concurrency and tokens/sec.
InfraBot: Automated: quota increase request form: https://redwood.internal/infra/quotas — include account_id 881922 in request.
Alice (Security): quick blockers: data residency (EU region available), SOC2 certs in our compliance pack, need answers on retention + deletion policy. please attach completed security questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/compliance/sec-questionnaire.pdf
Emma (Sales): pricing question: ballpark for hosted vs reserved for 2-week POC then potential month of pilot?
Liam (SE): rough hosted POC run: <$1k for light usage (low tokens). enterprise reserved baseline pricing starts at X per month (will have sales provide quote). I'll loop in Billing.
Noah (Solutions Engineer): POC timeline proposal: day 0-2 auth + SDK + env setup; day 3-7 ingestion + prompts; day 8-11 evals + perf tuning (batching/quantization hints); day 12-14 wrap, handoff + success report.
Alice (Security): for questionnaire, we need a named POC owner and list of endpoints that will touch customer data.
Emma (Sales): owner = Emma, SE lead = Liam, customer POC contact = sarah@acme.com. I'll upload questionnaire today.
Liam (SE): next steps: I’ll create a short runbook with commands, sample code, and retry/backoff recommendations (use exponential backoff, idempotency keys for mutate ops). ETA 3pm PT today. :thumbsup:
Emma (Sales): perfect — when you create the runbook tag @Noah and @Alice so they can review. thanks everyone!
